name: data-grid-server-query-prisma
title: Data Grid Server Query Prisma
author: gridcn
description: Runs the grid's sort, filter tree, quick search, row range, row count, set values, flat aggregates, and groups with the Prisma Client object API on PostgreSQL and SQLite: definePrismaColumnMap builds the column map, typed by a generated model, and createPrismaGridQuery returns fetchRows for useDataGridServerRows.
